title: Obligation-(C) identification, cluster exhaustiveness, and physical framing
html:
This is obligation (C) of Binding many-body series equals the jet-order filtration: B(K)=\sum_n m_e\,a_D^{(n)}: it identifies the two filtrations, leaving the per-term mass identity B_n = m_e\,a_D^{(n)} (the mass identity applied to each graded piece) and the kernel of the growth recurrence (The binding generating function's q-difference equation gives a depth-d recurrence) as the remaining inputs.

The grading rests on the Gröbner--Shirshov filtration (step 7, derived) read through the jet-prefix order (step 8); the exhaustiveness of the cluster decomposition — every contribution lives in some finite cluster degree — is the structural property of the atomic braid-word construction (each added nucleon raises the normal-form length by its block, so an n-cluster sub-word sits at degree n).

Though the proof reduces to a standard jet-degree equivalence argument, projecting the structural hypothesis onto this geometric form to explicitly equate bond order with the jet-degree of the extracted S field is a mathematically novel physical framing specific to the Quantum Observable Universe.
